scope: All214 translatable literal Tyashoi rows in frozen217 public rows;two neutral and one variable timer excluded. Original book-riddle title retained alongside Russian. Not live completeness.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Hmm.. You do not seem experienced enough for what I require.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Хм... Похоже, для моего поручения тебе пока не хватает опыта.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Come back to me when you have harmed more than a fly.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Возвращайся, когда научишься обижать кого-нибудь посерьёзнее мухи.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Must you need an explanation? I mean Combat Level 10 and 10 of playtime.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Тебе ещё и объяснять надо? Я имею в виду 10-й уровень боя и 10 часов игры.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: The Great Spook...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Великий ужас...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: It's THERE!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Он ТАМ!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: At least I think. You can never be too sure until it's really happening...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: По крайней мере, мне так кажется. Пока всё не началось, ни в чём нельзя быть уверенным...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Something has to be done, otherwise things are going to get way too spooky...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Нужно что-то делать, иначе станет слишком уж жутко...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Last time my assistant was alright.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: В прошлый раз помощник у меня был неплохой.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Was it you?
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Это был ты?

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Hum, I see.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Хм, понятно.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Well, last time my strategy worked really well.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Что ж, в прошлый раз моя стратегия отлично сработала.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: It was a genius plan to be fair.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Честно говоря, план был гениальный.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: So I'll go with a similar strategy this year.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Так что в этом году попробую нечто похожее.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Will you help me?
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Поможешь мне?

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I'll reward you if you give me the proper ingredients.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Принесёшь нужные ингредиенты — получишь награду.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: There is no time to explain.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Нет времени объяснять.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Anyways, I'll reward you if you give me the proper ingredients.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Как бы то ни было, за нужные ингредиенты я тебя награжу.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: You know I've heard these make great pies...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Знаешь, я слышал, из них получаются отличные пироги...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Anyway, let's throw this in the cauldron.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ладно, бросим это в котёл.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Hmmm. I think this confirms it...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Хмм... Кажется, это всё подтверждает...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: What did you say? Pfft. You wouldn't understand.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Что ты сказал? Пф-ф. Тебе не понять.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Pfft. Take your reward, this is a Great Spook Helmet.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Пф-ф. Забирай награду — Шлем Великого ужаса.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Do you really have feet instead of hands? How hard can it be to get 5 Decayed Bats?
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: У тебя что, ноги вместо рук? Неужели так сложно достать 5 разложившихся летучих мышей?

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Come back in 2d 23h 59m 59s and I may have more info about this ingredient.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Возвращайся через 2 д 23 ч 59 мин 59 с. Возможно, к тому времени я узнаю об этом ингредиенте больше.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Decayed Bats! Finally!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Разложившиеся летучие мыши! Наконец-то!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Let's add them to the brew...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Добавим их в варево...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Oof, that's not good. Not good at all.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ух, нехорошо. Совсем нехорошо.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Well, here is your reward. It's a Great Spook Chestplate.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Что ж, вот твоя награда — Нагрудник Великого ужаса.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Can you really not find a Poisoned Candy?!? This is basic Alchemy!!!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Неужели ты не можешь найти отравленную конфету?! Это же азы алхимии!!!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Come back in 1d 23h 59m 59s and I may have more info about this ingredient.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Возвращайся через 1 д 23 ч 59 мин 59 с. Возможно, к тому времени я узнаю об этом ингредиенте больше.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I need 12 Sweet Flesh.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Мне нужно 12 кусков сладкой плоти.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: You must bring them to me.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ты должен принести их мне.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Come back in 0d 23h 59m 59s and I may have more info about this ingredient.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Возвращайся через 0 д 23 ч 59 мин 59 с. Возможно, к тому времени я узнаю об этом ингредиенте больше.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Perfect! Let me put that Sweet Flesh in the cauldron!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Прекрасно! Брошу эту сладкую плоть в котёл!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Interesting... Most interesting...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Любопытно... Весьма любопытно...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Well... Here, take these Great Spook Boots!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Что ж... Держи Ботинки Великого ужаса!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: You're already having trouble finding a simple Rogue Flesh?
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ты уже не можешь найти даже обычную плоть отступника?

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: It's quite simple really, you are just lacking patience.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Это совсем несложно, тебе просто не хватает терпения.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Let's toss this right in.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Бросим это прямо сюда.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Rogue Flesh isn't really an ingredient I use often.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Плоть отступника — не тот ингредиент, которым я часто пользуюсь.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: In fact, this is my first time using it.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Вообще-то я использую её впервые.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I would say that went... well?
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Я бы сказал, всё прошло... хорошо?

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: How to obtain a Precious? Well...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Как достать Прелесть? Ну...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Just need to throw this right here...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Нужно лишь бросить это вот сюда...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Hum, impressive...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Хм, впечатляет...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Oh sorry, not you. I meant the experiment.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ой, прости, я не о тебе. Я об эксперименте.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: It's...very peculiar...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Это... очень необычно...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Wow, if I were you I wouldn't stay too close to this cauldron!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ого! На твоём месте я бы к котлу не приближался!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: If we have to work together, you may as well learn the basic safety procedures...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Раз уж нам работать вместе, выучи хотя бы основы техники безопасности...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I guess, to be fair, we'll probably both die when The Great Spook comes.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Хотя, если честно, когда придёт Великий ужас, мы, скорее всего, оба погибнем.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Here we go.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Начинаем.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I hope this cow didn't suffer.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Надеюсь, эта корова не страдала.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Knowing you, I don't know what to expect anymore.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Зная тебя, я уже не понимаю, чего ждать.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Of course I am.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Разумеется.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Look! Brown slashes!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Смотри! Коричневые штрихи!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: We are going in the right direction.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Мы движемся в верном направлении.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Fairy Wings are some of the most important ingredients!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Крылья феи — одни из важнейших ингредиентов!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Come on, I need them quick!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Давай же, они нужны мне срочно!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Come back in 4d 23h 59m 59s and I may have more info about this ingredient.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Возвращайся через 4 д 23 ч 59 мин 59 с. Возможно, к тому времени я узнаю об этом ингредиенте больше.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Fairy Wings, perfect.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Крылья феи, прекрасно.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: This is probably a good time to mention that what we are doing is not exactly... legal.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Наверное, стоит упомянуть, что наше занятие не совсем... законно.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: At least where I'm from it's not legal.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: По крайней мере, там, откуда я родом.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: But I think we have a good dynamic together.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Но, по-моему, мы с тобой отлично сработались.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Furthermore, if I go down, you'll also go down with me. Understand?
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: И потом, если меня повяжут, тебя тоже. Понятно?

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: This time I'm going to need a burger.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: На этот раз мне понадобится бургер.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: It's, hmm, quite important you see.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Это, хм, довольно важно, понимаешь.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: No no, not cook, just bring me the ingredients.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Нет-нет, готовить не надо, просто принеси ингредиенты.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Oh and no tomatoes please, and no pickles, I hate them.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: И без помидоров, пожалуйста. И без солёных огурцов, терпеть их не могу.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Who asked?
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Тебя кто-то спрашивал?

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: You know, all things considered, I've had worse assistants before.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Знаешь, если подумать, бывали у меня помощники и похуже.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: You did an alright job, Robyn.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ты неплохо справился, Робин.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: That's your name, right?
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ведь тебя так зовут?

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Anyhow, I have to prepare for the next Great Spook.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: В любом случае мне нужно готовиться к следующему Великому ужасу.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I'm going to need Ephemeral Gratitude x2.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Мне понадобится Мимолётная благодарность x2.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: If you have enough resources in your sacks it should be very easy.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Если в твоих мешках хватает ресурсов, это будет совсем просто.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Come back in 0d 11h 59m 59s and I may have more info about this ingredient.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Возвращайся через 0 д 11 ч 59 мин 59 с. Возможно, к тому времени я узнаю об этом ингредиенте больше.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ephemeral Gratitude x2...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Мимолётная благодарность x2...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Didn't I ask for 3?
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Разве я не просил 3?

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Anyways, this will work, hold on...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ладно, сгодится и так. Погоди...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: It did work, but 3 would have been better.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Сработало, но 3 было бы лучше.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Here, take this Great Spook Pet!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Держи питомца «Великий ужас»!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: His nickname is Eerie.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Его зовут Жутик.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Sewer Fish x10, oof those stink...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Канализационная рыба x10... Уф, ну и вонь...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Hold on, I need to throw them one by one.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Погоди, мне нужно бросать их по одной.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: This was embarrassing.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Неловко вышло.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: If you tell anyone that you saw me doing this, the Great Spook will be the least of your worries...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Если расскажешь кому-нибудь, что видел, чем я тут занимался, Великий ужас станет меньшей из твоих проблем...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Let's not talk about this anymore.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Больше не будем об этом.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: A Nightmare Nullifier! Great!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Подавитель кошмаров! Отлично!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Let's sloooooowly put that bad boy in there.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ме-е-едленно опустим эту штуковину внутрь.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Now we just wait.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Теперь просто ждём.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I think this should be enough, but it's always hard to tell with experiments like this.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Думаю, этого хватит, хотя с такими экспериментами никогда не угадаешь.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: In the meantime, take this Eerie Toy.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: А пока держи Жуткую игрушку.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: As it turns out, the Great Spook isn't technically a nightmare.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Выяснилось, что Великий ужас, строго говоря, не кошмар.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: So the Nightmare Nullifier didn't work, at all.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Так что Подавитель кошмаров не сработал. Вообще.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: It's really just a small change in horror nomenclature they did a little while ago.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Всего-то небольшое изменение в классификации ужасов, которое они недавно внесли.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Honestly I don't even know who makes those decisions.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Честно говоря, я даже не знаю, кто принимает такие решения.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: It's a shame though, a few years ago this would have been the solution.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Обидно. Ещё несколько лет назад это решило бы проблему.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I have another idea though, it's a little far-fetched however.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Но есть другая идея. Правда, немного притянутая за уши.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I need The Soup.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Мне нужен «Суп».

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: A sad painting, perfect.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Грустная картина, прекрасно.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: This should do the trick.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Это должно сработать.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: WOW!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: ОГО!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Alright this did some work. But it's not enough it seems.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Что ж, какой-то результат есть. Но, похоже, этого недостаточно.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I need to think some more, but take this.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Нужно ещё подумать. А пока держи.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: The painting indeed got us some massive progress.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Картина и правда сильно продвинула нас вперёд.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: So I do have another idea, I think this should be it.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Есть ещё одна идея. Думаю, на этот раз получится.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: It's so close, that I think just a few drops from a Potion of Secrets will get us there.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Мы так близко! Думаю, несколько капель Зелья тайн доведут дело до конца.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: A Potion of Secrets!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Зелье тайн!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: You must be a decent Alchemist too!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ты, должно быть, тоже неплохой алхимик!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Even though this brew is far from perfect, I've seen worse ones.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Варево далеко от совершенства, но я видел и похуже.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ah ha!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ага!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: The secrets are getting revealed.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Тайны начинают раскрываться.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: This is the final step.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Это последний шаг.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I thought about it a lot and I know exactly what we need.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Я долго думал и теперь точно знаю, что нам нужно.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Once again, it's a little far-fetched, but when I get creative it usually works out.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Опять немного притянуто за уши, но мои творческие решения обычно срабатывают.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: For this final ingredient, we are going to need a Shadows indicate riddles, illuminating unseen stars.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: В качестве последнего ингредиента нам нужна книга «Тени указывают на загадки, освещая незримые звёзды» (Shadows indicate riddles, illuminating unseen stars).

style_anchors.source: Shadows indicate riddles, illuminating unseen stars
style_anchors.target: «Тени указывают на загадки, освещая незримые звёзды» (Shadows indicate riddles, illuminating unseen stars)

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Good luck.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Удачи.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: A painful book, oh my.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Книга, полная боли... Ох.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: You probably don't want to read this by the way.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Кстати, вряд ли ты захочешь это читать.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: That's it!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Вот оно!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I did it!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: У меня получилось!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: The Great Spook!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Великий ужас!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: There is no time to explain. I need Pumpkins, fast.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Нет времени объяснять. Мне нужны тыквы, срочно.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: With this, there is a chance.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: С этим у нас есть шанс.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: A fate worse than death itself will befall us now.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Теперь нас ждёт участь хуже самой смерти.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: It's close, way too close.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Он близко. Слишком близко.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: The Great Spook is near, it has never been closer.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Великий ужас близко. Ещё никогда он не был так близок.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: We have to do something about it.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Нужно что-то с этим делать.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: And when I say "we", I mean "I".
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: И под «мы» я подразумеваю «я».

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I'm the only one who can do anything about it.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Только я способен хоть что-нибудь сделать.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Everyone else is profoundly useless.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Все остальные совершенно бесполезны.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Anyways, I'm going to need a list of ingredients.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Как бы то ни было, мне потребуется целый список ингредиентов.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Last time, I tried to combat Spook with more Spook.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: В прошлый раз я пытался победить ужас ещё большим ужасом.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: This time I am going with a different approach.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: На этот раз попробую другой подход.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Furthermore, if I go down, you'll go down with me. Understand?
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: И потом, если меня повяжут, тебя тоже. Понятно?

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Well, well, well.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ну надо же.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Looks like I saved the world once again.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Похоже, я опять спас мир.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: This should give us enough time to prepare for The Great Spook.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Это даст нам достаточно времени, чтобы подготовиться к Великому ужасу.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Done?
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Всё?

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Oh, no no no.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: О, нет-нет-нет.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: The Great Spook will come, it cannot be stopped.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Великий ужас придёт. Его не остановить.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I simply delayed it.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Я лишь отсрочил его приход.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ok, this looked better in my head.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ладно, в моей голове это выглядело лучше.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Honestly, I would get that ingredient myself but my legs are not as good anymore.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Честно говоря, я бы сам достал этот ингредиент, но ноги уже не те.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: And I'm also a nyctophobe, which is why I need to stop The Great Spook from happening.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: А ещё я боюсь темноты, поэтому мне и нужно предотвратить Великий ужас.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: It's quite simple.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Всё довольно просто.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: You just have to kill a Zombie with a Sweet item!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Нужно лишь убить зомби сладким предметом!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Well, here, take these Great Spook Boots!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Что ж, держи Ботинки Великого ужаса!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Quick! I really need you to craft me a Poisoned Candy.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Скорее! Мне очень нужно, чтобы ты сделал отравленную конфету.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Amazing!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Потрясающе!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: You know candy is bad for you, works well in potions though.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Знаешь, конфеты вредны для здоровья, зато для зелий отлично подходят.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Wait...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Погоди...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Why were you holding this Poisoned Candy with your bare hands, do you really know NOTHING???
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Зачем ты брал отравленную конфету голыми руками? Ты что, вообще НИЧЕГО не знаешь???

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Amateurism at it's finest!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Дилетантство в чистом виде!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Moving on, let's add this Poisoned Candy to the brew.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Продолжим. Добавим эту отравленную конфету в варево.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I see..
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Понятно...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Here, take these Great Spook Leggings, you earned them!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Держи Поножи Великого ужаса, ты их заслужил!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: You still haven't managed to make a bat wither?
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ты до сих пор не сумел иссушить летучую мышь?

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Have you not been using those sub-zero materials? Go on and fetch those Decayed Bats!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Разве ты не пользовался материалами с минусовой температурой? Иди и принеси разложившихся летучих мышей!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Well, here's your reward. It's a Great Spook Chestplate.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Что ж, вот твоя награда — Нагрудник Великого ужаса.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Nice, we are finally getting somewhere!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Отлично, наконец-то дело сдвинулось с мёртвой точки!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: You know, I've heard these make great pies...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Знаешь, я слышал, из них получаются отличные пироги...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Pfft. Take your rewards, this is a Great Spook Helmet.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Пф-ф. Забирай награду — Шлем Великого ужаса.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Please hurry up and fish up those 10 Frozen Spiders.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Поторопись, пожалуйста, и вылови 10 замёрзших пауков.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Oh my! The final ingredient.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ох! Последний ингредиент.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: This is very stressful, I hope my calculations are correct.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Как же я волнуюсь. Надеюсь, в расчётах нет ошибки.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Well, here goes nothing!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ну, была не была!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Hmmm. Well this is quite embarrassing.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Хмм... Неловко получилось.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I don't actually understand what just happened.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Я, вообще-то, не понимаю, что сейчас произошло.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I will need to study this brew back in my laboratory.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Нужно будет изучить это варево у себя в лаборатории.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I really hope I won't have to work with you ever again, but here. Take your Great Spook Staff.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Очень надеюсь, что больше не придётся с тобой работать. Но держи — твой Посох Великого ужаса.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Despite your complete lack of talent, I thank you for your help.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Несмотря на твою полную бездарность, благодарю за помощь.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I have to go back to work now.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: А теперь мне пора возвращаться к работе.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Hmm... you do not seem experienced enough for what I require.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Хм... Похоже, для моего поручения тебе пока не хватает опыта.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Hey you! Have you ever heard of the Great Spook?
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Эй, ты! Слышал когда-нибудь о Великом ужасе?

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Well, don't worry about it, but I need to do some research.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ладно, не забивай этим голову. Но мне нужно кое-что исследовать.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: If you bring me the items I need for my brew I'll reward you with armor and a staff!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Принесёшь всё необходимое для моего варева — награжу тебя бронёй и посохом!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: The first ingredient required is a Sweet Flesh.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Первый ингредиент — сладкая плоть.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I need 12 of them.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Мне нужно 12 штук.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Really? Still nothing?
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Серьёзно? Всё ещё ничего?

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: It's quite simple though.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Но это же совсем просто.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I said Sweet Flesh... Find them.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Я сказал: сладкая плоть... Найди её.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: That's not enough! I need 12 Sweet Flesh!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Этого мало! Мне нужно 12 кусков сладкой плоти!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: My sweet tooth is acting up again...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Опять сладкого захотелось...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I know! Obviously a Poisoned Candy will take care of that. Find one for me.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Придумал! Отравленная конфета точно поможет. Найди мне одну.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Now, look here. I obviously need 5 Decayed Bat pronto!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Слушай сюда. Мне срочно нужны 5 разложившихся летучих мышей!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I need those Decayed Bats for YESTERDAY!!!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Эти разложившиеся летучие мыши нужны мне ещё ВЧЕРА!!!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: That's not enough! I need 5 Decayed Bat!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Этого мало! Мне нужно 5 разложившихся летучих мышей!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Wet! It needs to be wet! Pumpkins!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Мокрые! Они должны быть мокрыми! Тыквы!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Actually just one...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Вообще-то нужна всего одна...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Yes! A single Wet Pumpkin! Go now!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Да! Одна мокрая тыква! Иди же!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Needs more of a bite... Hmmm.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Не хватает остроты... Хмм.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Spiders! Oh but wait... Ice... Hmm.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Пауки! Хотя постой... Лёд... Хм.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Quite clearly, the last ingredient I need is 10 Frozen Spiders...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Очевидно, последний ингредиент — 10 замёрзших пауков...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Frozen Spiders! Yup that's it. I need that next. Go fetch.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Замёрзшие пауки! Да, точно. Они нужны следующими. Принеси.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: That's not enough! I need 10 Frozen Spider!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Этого мало! Мне нужно 10 замёрзших пауков!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Hmm? Oh you.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Мм? А, это ты.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Thanks for all that. I guess.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Спасибо за всё. Наверное.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: In the future I may need you again, but for now that is all.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Возможно, ты ещё мне понадобишься, но пока это всё.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Hmmm. I'm going to need some time to decide which ingredient I need next.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Хмм... Мне нужно время, чтобы решить, какой ингредиент понадобится следующим.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: You... Look familiar.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ты... Кажешься знакомым.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I've seen you before...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Я тебя уже видел...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: You may wear different clothes but I recognise that face anywhere.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ты можешь сменить одежду, но это лицо я узнаю где угодно.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I will not work with you here.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Здесь я с тобой работать не стану.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I'm sorry, I'm not ready for you yet...
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Прости, я пока ещё не готов...

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Come back in 3-5 business days and I will have something for you.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Возвращайся через 3-5 рабочих дней, и у меня для тебя кое-что будет.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Please, I really need your help! I need a Poisoned Candy as soon as possible!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Пожалуйста, мне очень нужна твоя помощь! Скорее принеси отравленную конфету!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Can you really not find a Poisoned Candy?!? This is basic Alchemy!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Неужели ты не можешь найти отравленную конфету?! Это же азы алхимии!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Quick! I really need you to craft me a Poisoned Candy!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Скорее! Мне очень нужно, чтобы ты сделал отравленную конфету!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I can't finish my work without those Decayed Bats!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Без этих разложившихся летучих мышей я не закончу работу!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Do I really need to repeat? I need a Wet Pumpkin!
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Мне что, повторять? Нужна мокрая тыква!

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Repeat after me. WET. PUMPKIN.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Повторяй за мной. МОКРАЯ. ТЫКВА.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: I don't appreciate your nonchalant attitude, these Frozen Spiders are extremely important.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Мне не нравится твоё безразличие. Эти замёрзшие пауки чрезвычайно важны.

records.speaker: Tyashoi Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: You clearly don't realize the gravity of the situation, come back once you found 10 Frozen Spider.
records.translation: [NPC] Tyashoi Alchemist: Ты явно не осознаёшь серьёзность ситуации. Возвращайся, когда найдёшь 10 замёрзших пауков.
